text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...No good, once more from the top. Step 
in with power, use the knees flexibly and 
rhythmically..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You remember the choreography? That was 
the assignment for dance lessons, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care to use me as 
a reference?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Learned it in no time flat. Now all 
that's left is to dance to our hearts' 
content."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Ah, right there... I think 
that's a bit off. That's the same step 
I've been stuck on."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see. Then I'll check the 
choreography in the video— All right, got 
it down. One more time.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Memorizing the choreography in record 
time, followed by relentless practice... 
How very like you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for you, Believe. Striving 
for perfection, working diligently with a 
craftsman's spirit. Same as ever.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Because this is the only way I know.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's true. We're in the same boat.
